title: What Happens When a Planet Orbits Two Suns?
description: Watch how a planet navigates the shifting gravitational pull of a binary star system before its orbit changes forever.

shots.narration: A distant planet orbits two suns at the same time, weaving a wide loop around their shared center of gravity.
As the twin stars swing close together, their shifting gravity constantly tugs the planet onto a brand new path.
One close pass transfers enough motion to hurl the planet away forever, leaving the two suns behind in peace.
